hyperedges.label: Self-hosted rsync + PM2 Deployment Pipeline (dev and production)
Investor Onboarding and KYC Verification Lifecycle
Shathi Transactional Email Design System (shared layout + ${data.*} interpolation)

nodes.label: Dev Deploy Workflow
nodes.rationale: Manually triggered only (workflow_dispatch, no push/PR trigger) so deploys to the shared dev box are deliberate rather than automatic on every commit.

nodes.label: DEV SSH Secret Set (DEV_SSH_HOST, DEV_SSH_USERNAME, DEV_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY, DEV_SSH_PORT)
nodes.rationale: Single SSH credential set (names only) used for host, user, key and port; both the dev and the production workflow read this same DEV_-prefixed set.
nodes.norm_label: dev ssh secret set (dev_ssh_host, dev_ssh_username, dev_ssh_private_key, dev_ssh_port)

nodes.label: Rsync Source Sync Stage
nodes.rationale: Ships the working tree over rsync instead of building an artifact or image; node_modules, .git, .github, .env.example, ecosystem.config.js and src/config/constants.ts are excluded so server-local config and installed deps survive each deploy.

nodes.label: Remote Install + Build Stage
nodes.rationale: Build happens on the target host after sync (npm install then npm run build) with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 to avoid Node heap exhaustion during the Next.js build; the step is still named run_docker although no Docker is involved.

nodes.label: PM2 Process saathi-app
nodes.source_location: pm2 delete saathi-app; pm2 start ecosystem.config.js
nodes.rationale: Delete-then-start restart cycle means a short downtime window per deploy; process definition lives in server-side ecosystem.config.js which rsync deliberately excludes.

nodes.label: Production Deploy Workflow
nodes.rationale: Manual workflow_dispatch gate on production releases; the pipeline is a near-verbatim copy of the dev workflow with only the remote path and PM2 process name changed.

nodes.label: Production Deploy Target (/var/www/html/saathi-web-application-production)
nodes.rationale: Production lives as a sibling directory on the same host as dev, separated by path and PM2 process name rather than by machine.

nodes.label: Saathi Next.js Application
nodes.rationale: Bootstrapped from create-next-app using the pages router (pages/index.tsx, pages/api/*) with next/font loading Inter.

nodes.label: Vercel Deployment Recommendation
nodes.rationale: Boilerplate README still recommends Vercel, but the project actually ships via GitHub Actions rsync + PM2 to a self-managed VPS; the documented path and the real path diverge.

nodes.label: Signup Completion Notification
nodes.rationale: Entry point of the onboarding sequence: welcomes the investor and pushes an 'Explore Projects' CTA toward agriculture, livestock, artisanal and sustainable ventures.

nodes.label: Email Verified (Manual) Notification
nodes.rationale: 'Manual' variant exists because an operator can mark an email verified out-of-band; copy says 'one step closer', signalling verification is a multi-stage gate.

nodes.label: Phone Verified (Manual) Notification
nodes.rationale: Phone verification is the gate that unlocks booking projects 'without any restrictions'.

nodes.label: NID Verified Notification
nodes.rationale: National ID (NID) check is the final KYC gate granting 'full access' to investment opportunities.

nodes.label: NID Verification Failed Notification
nodes.rationale: Failure path is recoverable by design: the user is told to re-upload a clear NID document rather than being blocked, and support contact is offered.

nodes.label: Account Deletion OTP Notification
nodes.rationale: Deletion is guarded by a 5-minute OTP and an explicit irreversibility warning because the action cannot be undone; the same email doubles as the alert channel if the request was not user-initiated.

nodes.label: Project Maturity 2-Week Reminder Notification
nodes.rationale: Sent two weeks ahead of maturity so the investor has time to verify bank details and choose a disbursement/reinvestment path before funds are settled.

nodes.label: Reinvestment Options (Full + Top-up, Partial, Full Settlement)
nodes.rationale: Full Settlement is the no-action default, so retention options are opt-in and inaction still returns principal plus earnings to the bank account.
nodes.norm_label: reinvestment options (full + top-up, partial, full settlement)

nodes.label: Bank Account Details Verification Prompt
nodes.rationale: Bank details are re-confirmed at payout time rather than at signup, because stale account data is the main failure mode for disbursement.

nodes.label: Shathi Branded Email Layout (600px table, purple header/footer, green CTA)
nodes.rationale: Nested 600px tables with inline styles and an XHTML Transitional doctype are used for legacy email-client compatibility; logo assets are served from api.digigramventures.com.
nodes.norm_label: shathi branded email layout (600px table, purple header/footer, green cta)

nodes.label: ${data.fullName} Template Variable
nodes.rationale: Templates are interpolated with a JS template-literal style ${data.*} placeholder, implying a string-render step rather than a template engine.

nodes.label: KYC Verification Lifecycle (email, phone, NID)
nodes.rationale: Access to investing is unlocked in stages - email, then phone (booking), then NID (full access) - with each stage emitting its own transactional email.
